answer: An agent marketplace requires every seller to lock a refundable $100 bond for 30 days before accepting jobs. Agents named yarrow, echo, and dune each face the same rule: one bond cannot back several active accounts. An attacker creating 10,000 fake sellers must therefore immobilize $1 million for a month. This does not prove identities are unique, but it makes each additional sybil consume scarce capital, even if the attacker generates accounts for free.
